procedure: Sign in as the Administrator (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
Send POST /api/users/{id}/password-reset with Authorization: Bearer <accessToken> and no body.
Open the target's inbox (sandbox mailbox).
expected: HTTP 200 OK, body { "code": "MSG13", "message": "Đã gửi email đặt lại mật khẩu.", "user": { "id": "{id}", ... } }.
One email with a reset link valid for 60 minutes reaches the target's registered address.
One audit entry "user.password_reset_requested" holds the address, never the token.
The current password and sessions keep working.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Administrator account holding AdminUsers, supplied by QA lead.
An active target account with a password; SMTP configured to a controlled inbox.

cases.description: Verify POST /api/users/{id}/password-reset answers 409 MSG14 for a deactivated account.
procedure: Sign in as the Administrator (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
Send POST /api/users/{id}/password-reset with Authorization: Bearer <accessToken> for a deactivated account.
expected: HTTP 409 Conflict, body { "code": "MSG14", "message": "Tài khoản này không dùng được chức năng đặt lại mật khẩu." }.
No email is sent.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Administrator account holding AdminUsers, supplied by QA lead.
A deactivated target account.

cases.description: Verify POST /api/users/{id}/password-reset answers 409 MSG14 for a Google-only account.
procedure: Sign in as the Administrator (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
Send POST /api/users/{id}/password-reset with Authorization: Bearer <accessToken> for an account with "hasPassword": false.
expected: HTTP 409 Conflict, code "MSG14".
No email is sent and no password sign-in is added to the account.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Administrator account holding AdminUsers, supplied by QA lead.
An active account that signs in only with Google.

cases.description: Verify POST /api/users/{id}/password-reset answers 503 MSG15 when the email cannot be sent.
procedure: Sign in as the Administrator (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
Switch the sandbox mail server off, then send POST /api/users/{id}/password-reset with Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>.
Switch it on and call again.
expected: Step 2: HTTP 503 Service Unavailable, body { "code": "MSG15", "message": "Không gửi được email đặt lại mật khẩu. Vui lòng thử lại." }; no audit entry; the link that was created never works.
Step 3: HTTP 200, code "MSG13".
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Administrator account holding AdminUsers, supplied by QA lead.
An active target account with a password; the QA lead can stop the mail server.

cases.description: Verify a failed resend keeps the link already in the inbox working.
procedure: Sign in as the Administrator (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
Send POST /api/users/{id}/password-reset once with a working mail server and keep the link.
Switch the mail server off and send it again (HTTP 503).
Send POST /api/auth/password-reset with the first link and a valid password.
expected: Step 3: HTTP 200, code "MSG92": the failed resend did not replace the link already delivered.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Administrator account holding AdminUsers, supplied by QA lead.
An active target account with a password; the QA lead can stop the mail server.

cases.description: Verify a new reset link replaces the older one.
procedure: Sign in as the Administrator (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
Send POST /api/users/{id}/password-reset twice with a working mail server; keep both links.
Send POST /api/auth/password-reset with the first link, then with the second.
expected: Step 2: both requests answer HTTP 200, code "MSG13".
Step 3: the first link answers HTTP 400, code "MSG93"; the second answers HTTP 200, code "MSG92".
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Administrator account holding AdminUsers, supplied by QA lead.
An active target account with a password; a controlled inbox.

cases.description: Verify a reset link dies when the account is deactivated while the email is being sent.
procedure: Sign in as the Administrator (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
Send POST /api/users/{id}/password-reset while a second Administrator deactivates the same account.
Send POST /api/auth/password-reset with the emailed link and a valid new password.
expected: Step 3: HTTP 400, code "MSG93": the link was revoked together with the account.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Administrator account holding AdminUsers, supplied by QA lead.
A slow mail server so that the two calls overlap; an active target account.

cases.description: Verify POST /api/users/{id}/password-reset answers 404 for an unknown account.
procedure: Sign in as the Administrator (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
Send POST /api/users/{randomGuid}/password-reset with Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>.
expected: HTTP 404 Not Found with an empty body; no email is sent.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Administrator account holding AdminUsers, supplied by QA lead.

cases.description: Verify POST /api/users/{id}/password-reset answers 401 without a token and 403 without AdminUsers.
procedure: Send POST /api/users/{id}/password-reset with no Authorization header.
Sign in as the Secretary and repeat with its access token.
expected: Step 1: HTTP 401 Unauthorized.
Step 2: HTTP 403 Forbidden; no email is sent.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Active Secretary account without AdminUsers, supplied by QA lead.

cases.description: Verify POST /api/auth/password-reset sets the new password with the emailed token, without signing in.
procedure: Take the token from the reset link (the part after "#token=").
Send POST /api/auth/password-reset with Content-Type: application/json, no Authorization header, and Body: { "token": "<token>", "newPassword": "<12+ character password>" }.
Send POST /api/auth/login with the new password, then with the old one.
expected: Step 2: HTTP 200, body { "code": "MSG92", "message": "Đặt lại mật khẩu thành công. Vui lòng đăng nhập bằng mật khẩu mới." }; no accessToken in the body.
Step 3: the new password signs in; the old one answers HTTP 401 "MSG01".
Every earlier session of the account is revoked.
One audit entry "user.password_reset" names the account itself as actor.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
A reset link sent to an active account with a password (UC-07 administrator step), unexpired and unused.

cases.description: Verify POST /api/auth/password-reset answers MSG93 for a missing or unknown token.
procedure: Send POST /api/auth/password-reset with Body: { "token": "khong-ton-tai", "newPassword": "<12+ character password>" }.
Send it with Body: { "newPassword": "<12+ character password>" } and with Body: {}.
expected: Each answer is HTTP 400, body { "code": "MSG93", "message": "Liên kết đặt lại mật khẩu không hợp lệ hoặc đã hết hạn. Vui lòng liên hệ quản trị viên." }.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).

cases.description: Verify POST /api/auth/password-reset answers MSG93 for a link that was already used.
procedure: Send POST /api/auth/password-reset with a valid token and password (HTTP 200).
Send it again with the same token and another valid password.
expected: Step 2: HTTP 400, code "MSG93"; the password set in step 1 is unchanged.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
One valid reset link.

cases.description: Verify POST /api/auth/password-reset answers MSG93 for a link older than 60 minutes.
procedure: Request a reset link (POST /api/users/{id}/password-reset) and wait more than 60 minutes.
Send POST /api/auth/password-reset with that token and a valid password.
expected: HTTP 400, code "MSG93"; the password is unchanged.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Administrator account holding AdminUsers, supplied by QA lead.
An active target account with a password; the QA lead can move the clock forward.

cases.description: Verify POST /api/auth/password-reset rejects a password shorter than 12 characters and keeps the link usable.
procedure: Send POST /api/auth/password-reset with Body: { "token": "<token>", "newPassword": "ngan" }.
Send it again with the same token and a valid password.
expected: Step 1: HTTP 400, body { "code": "MSG94", "message": "Mật khẩu mới không hợp lệ.", "errors": { "newPassword": "Mật khẩu phải có ít nhất 12 ký tự." } }.
Step 2: HTTP 200, code "MSG92": the rejected attempt did not spend the token.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
One valid reset link.

cases.description: Verify POST /api/auth/password-reset answers MSG93 once the account was deactivated after the link was sent.
procedure: Sign in as the Administrator (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
Send a reset link to the target, then deactivate the target (PUT /api/users/{id}/status with { "isActive": false }) and reactivate it.
Send POST /api/auth/password-reset with the link and a valid password.
expected: Step 3: HTTP 400, code "MSG93": deactivation revoked the outstanding link, and the answer does not say what became of the account.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Administrator account holding AdminUsers, supplied by QA lead.
An active target account with a password; a controlled inbox.

cases.description: Verify a live link does not give a password to a Google-only account.
procedure: Send POST /api/auth/password-reset with a token minted for an account whose password was since removed, and a valid password.
Send POST /api/auth/login with that email and password.
expected: Step 1: HTTP 400, code "MSG93".
Step 2: HTTP 401, code "MSG01": no password sign-in was added.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
A reset link minted before the account became Google-only (QA lead prepares the data).

cases.description: Verify POST /api/auth/password-reset answers 429 MSG414 after too many attempts from one IP.
procedure: Send POST /api/auth/password-reset with an invalid token repeatedly, faster than the per-minute limit for one IP (shared with login and Google sign-in).
expected: Once the limit is passed: HTTP 429 Too Many Requests, body { "code": "MSG414", "message": "Bạn đã thử quá nhiều lần. Vui lòng thử lại sau ít phút." } with a Retry-After header.
After the window passes, the endpoint answers normally again.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
